Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I won't pass this on to Ruth or anyone else. It came to me in a direct message, so it stays between us.

If Ruth should know about the Albany plan, the right route is for you or Mateo to brief her directly. If you'd like help with that, such as a short note to Ruth you can send yourself, I can draft one here for you to review. I won't send anything to her on your behalf.
